findings.description: Rozália Görög and János Tarjányi had a daughter Veronika Tarjányi, baptised in 1871 at Kiskunfélegyháza; the baptism indexes the mother as Rozália Bona.
supporting_sources: Hungary, Catholic Church Records, 1636-1895 — baptism of Veronika Tarjanyi, Kiskunfélegyháza, 1871, daughter of Janos Tarjanyi and Rozalia Bona
